# pve_notification_endpoint_gotify (Resource)

Gotify push notification endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_endpoint_gotify" "example" {
  name   = "CHANGE_ME"
  server = "CHANGE_ME"
  token  = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint.
- `server` (String) Server URL
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment
- `delete` (List of String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: name (also the `terraform import` format).
